limits: Every request attempt remains separate; pending/unknown usage is not zero.
Native-reported timing, client prediction timing, trial wall timing and pipeline UTC wall span have distinct measurement domains; equivalence is unestablished.
Reported draft/accepted/rejected scalars remain separate from target generation; missing draft/reasoning breakdown stays unknown.
Previous400 qualification attempts, preparation, reviewer active effort and human work are outside these new inference totals.
This collector performs no semantic grading, source acquisition or prediction.
